hibernate-mapping.query: from Dier as d where d.id = :Id
select count(d.id) from Dier as d where d.chipPasnummer = :Id
select count(rasId) from Dier as d where d.rasId = :Id
select count(voedingCategorieId) from Dier as d where d.voedingCategorieId = :Id
select count(dierVachtId) from Dier as d where d.dierVachtId = :Id
select count(kleur) from Dier as d where d.kleur = :Id
select count(pensionEigenschapId) from Dier as d where d.pensionEigenschapId = :Id
select count(pensionPrijsCategorieId) from Dier as d where d.pensionPrijsCategorieId = :Id
select count(l.dierenartsId) from Dier as d inner join d.lichaamelijkId as l where l.dierenartsId = :Id

select d from Factuur as f, Dier as d inner join f.factuurRegels as regel where regel.dierId = d.id and ((f.gereserveerdVan <= :BeginDatum and (f.gereserveerdTot is null or f.gereserveerdTot >= :EindDatum)) or (f.gereserveerdVan >= :BeginDatum and f.gereserveerdVan <= :EindDatum) or (f.gereserveerdTot >= :BeginDatum and f.gereserveerdTot <= :EindDatum)) and d.id = :DierId and d.overleden = false

select distinct k from Dier as d inner join d.klantId as k inner join d.rasId as ras where lower(d.naam) like lower(:ZoekWaarde) or lower(ras.naam) like lower(:ZoekWaarde) or d.chipPasnummer = :StaticWaarde order by k.achternaam
